ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: During flu season, a city medical center needs to keep a large supply of flu shots. A nurse’s aid compiles data on the number of flu shots given per day in the past few years during flu season. A cumulative probability chart of the collected data is as follows: How many flu shots should the center store every day to meet the demand on 95 percent of the days?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a cumulative probability curve, with the horizontal axis labeled “Number of flu shots”, ranging approximately from 100 to 300; the vertical axis labeled “Cumulative probability”, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The curve starts to rise from a low probability near about 120 shots, increases rapidly between 160 and 190 shots, and approaches 0.95 around 200 shots, then gradually approaches 1.0. Reasoning: The question asks to store enough flu vaccines each day to meet 95% of daily demand. Therefore, find the cumulative probability 0.95 on the vertical axis, move horizontally to the curve, then read downward to the horizontal axis; the corresponding quantity is about 200 shots. Because it is necessary to satisfy at least 95% of the days, the storage amount should be taken as not less than this value.

method.method_draft: First describe the chart as a cumulative distribution of daily flu-shot demand. From the text, convert the requirement into a shortage condition: the center can run out on no more than 5% of days. On the cumulative graph, look for the smallest number of shots where the curve has risen high enough that only the upper tail remains, i.e., where cumulative probability is about 1.00 - 0.05 = 0.95. Reading along the curve, this happens around 200 shots; lower amounts such as around 180 still leave more than 5% of days above the stored amount. Therefore the minimum safe daily stock is at least 200 shots.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一张“Number of flu shots”和“Cumulative probability”的累积概率曲线图。横轴表示每天需要的流感疫苗针数，大约从100到300；纵轴表示累积概率，从0.0到1.0。曲线呈S形，随着针数增加，累积概率逐渐上升，并在约200针附近接近0.95到1.0的高概率区域。
推理：题目要求每天储存的疫苗数量能满足95%的日期需求，也就是只有不超过5%的日期会因为需求超过库存而短缺。在累积分布图上，这对应于寻找最小的针数，使得累积概率约为0.95。沿着图中的曲线读取，累积概率达到约0.95的位置在大约200针处；低于这个数量，例如约180针时，累积概率还明显低于0.95，会留下超过5%的日期需求无法满足。因此，医疗中心每天至少应储存200针流感疫苗。
